errors.evidence:
The list of x-axis labels provided contains numerous transcription errors. For example, it lists "Ols" instead of "O/s", "A\s" instead of "A/s", "Hnd" instead of "Hn/nd", "Dai
" instead of "Da/n", "O
" instead of "O/nd", "V\u" instead of "Vt/vi", "Jbc" instead of "Jb/c", "A
" instead of "A/n-Hn/v", and so on. Almost every label cited is incorrect.

The description states the highest value is 'close to 1000'. However, on the logarithmic y-axis, the bar for 'A/n' is clearly below the midpoint between 100 and 1000, at a value of approximately 400-500. 'Close to 1000' is a significant overestimation.
The description incorrectly identifies the category with the highest value as 'A\n'. The correct label on the x-axis is 'A/n'.
